name: windows-time-resync
title: Resync the clock
description: Starts the Windows Time service if it is stopped and forces a resync with its time source (w32tm /resync /force). Before and after are the measured offset from that source. It does not change the time zone.
measure: if (-not $server -or $server -match '\s') { return 'not measurable (no network time source)' }
if (-not $m.Count) { return "not measurable ($server did not answer)" }
Add-ArhItem 'Clock offset' $(if ($src) { Get-ArhOffset $src } else { 'not measurable (service not running)' })
if (-not $svc) { Add-ArhBlocker 'The Windows Time service is missing' }
elseif ("$($svc.StartType)" -eq 'Disabled') { Add-ArhBlocker 'The Windows Time service is disabled' }
if ($src -match 'Local CMOS Clock|Free-running System Clock') { Add-ArhBlocker 'No network time source is configured' }
Set-ArhPlan $true $(if ($svc -and "$($svc.Status)" -ne 'Running') { 'Start the Windows Time service and resync' } else { "Resync with $src" })
